note:
configmanager option registration, 4750 -> 4407 (-343), measured on a clean worktree at HEAD d17ed6ff736 with only this commit applied. The shared checkout measured the same 4407, but that agreement is luck, not method -- see the clean-tree rule in doc/architecture/gates.md.

Two movements, only one of them this commit:
  - -50 unattributed: d17ed6ff736 stripped prose comments from odoo/odoo and did not re-floor, so the gate had gone red in the improvement direction again (4750 floor against 4700 actual) within a commit of the last re-floor. Absorbed here.
  - -293 this commit: configmanager._add_database_options (293 lines) and _add_common_options (160) are gone from the over-budget list, and odoo/tools/config.py now has NO function over 80.

This is the same move the gate was created by. py_function_length.py exists because configmanager._build_cli stood at 1024 lines of consecutive parser.add_option calls -- trivial branch count, so c901 scored it clean -- and splitting it into eleven _add_*_options methods is the worked example in its module docstring. Two of those eleven were still 293 and 160. They are now eight: _add_db_endpoint_options, _add_db_replica_and_tls_options, _add_db_pool_sizing_options, _add_db_connection_lifecycle_options, _add_db_session_and_health_options, _add_config_and_module_options, _add_import_and_process_options, _add_path_and_load_options.

The split falls on CONTIGUOUS RUNS, not on themes, and that constraint is the interesting part: optparse renders --help in the order options are added, so regrouping primary next to replica -- which is what the names would want, since --db_host and --db_replica_host are interleaved with --db_port and --db_replica_port -- would have silently reordered `odoo-bin server --help`. Preserving order costs one honest outlier (--db-template is neither a size nor a limit and rides in the sizing method) and that is commented at the site.

Equivalence proved rather than argued: the full optparse surface was dumped before and after -- 114 options across 11 groups, every attribute of every option including dest, type, my_default, env_name, cli_loadable, choices and help, plus group titles, parser.defaults, and the rendered format_help() text -- and the two JSON dumps are byte-identical.
